grading_summary_v2.overall_accuracy_note: overall accuracy only after manual grading fields are completed

metric_definitions.A_final_answer_accuracy: Share of tasks with correct final answer (auto v1.2 or human decision). Independent of tool-set.
metric_definitions.B_exact_tool_set_success: Share of tasks where predicted invoke set exactly equals gold set.
metric_definitions.C_strict_overall_task_success: answer correct AND exact tool set AND all invocations successful AND dependency OK when applicable AND refusal OK when applicable AND evidence correct or N/A.

final_grading_summary_v2.note: A, B, and C are separate metrics and must not be substituted for each other.

change_explanations.explanation: v1.1 required literal unit tokens (e.g. 'percent', 'cny'+'million'); v1.2 accepts % / RMB↔CNY aliases and semantic units such as decimal_return.
v1.2 normalizes Unicode minus and matches percent↔decimal and million↔raw/billion scale forms with scaled tolerances.
OHLC / unadjusted-qfq-hfq / MA+return dict gold_values are now auto-gradable via label binding instead of manual_required.
Refusal items that answer with numeric substitutes remain incorrect; status-only refusals without fabricated targets remain correct.
